title: Customizing Your Site
excerpt: Learn how to customize your site's appearance and behavior using templates and settings.
content:
Customization is key to making your site unique. HaruCMS provides several ways to customize your site:

  • Edit templates to change the appearance
  • Configure site settings
  • Add custom CSS and JavaScript
  • Install plugins for additional functionality

With these tools, you have full control over your site's look and feel.
